forum.title: Top marking LD59015C33R
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @Dillo, to the community!

The marking code is internal information, which is why it is not published - but the code is always also on the sticker on the packaging bag. Please note that all variants of the LD59015 are marked as NRND and may be discontinued at any time.

I hope to make you happy if I list the marking codes here:

* LD59015C12R: 592

* LD59015C15R: 593

* LD59015C18R: 594

* LD59015C25R: 595

* LD59015C30R: 597

* LD59015C33R: 596

Attention: the markings for LD59015C33R and LD59015C30R were not confused here.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
